title: Buddha Buzz Weekly: Refuge Recovery Splits
author: Jensen, Karen; Abrahams, Matthew
what_it_supports: Appendix A12.4. It is the independent account of the 2019 split that HANDOFF.md listed as missing; everything the appendix previously said about the schism came from the successor fellowship's own literature.
the_correction: It refines rather than confirms. Both organizations describe their meetings as peer-led and democratically run, so the difference is not that one is peer-led and the other is not. What separates them is the layer above the meeting: the continuing body retained associated teacher-led retreats and professional treatment options, and the successor did not.
sensitive_handling: This article names the predecessor's founder. The project does not, and tools/check_book.py enforces that. Only structural and governance facts are drawn from it; no allegation about any individual is repeated or adjudicated here.
